label: Fundraising Agent
blurb: Screens funds and programs against your own filter, builds a dated funding plan, drafts applications and investor emails — never sends them — and tracks every conversation.

suggestions.q: Set up my fundraising profile. Pull everything you can from this brain, my deck and my facts file first — then ask me only the decisions: the round, my minimum cheque, where I can raise from, entity, cofounder stance, exclusions and how autonomous you should be.

Build my funding plan: screen every target against my filter chain, verify the survivors on their own sites (tell me the fan-out before you spend it), then write the Funding Plan with the ledger, a dated timeline, the tiers, the decisions I owe and what to do this week.

Screen a list of investors or programs. I'll paste it or drop a CSV next — import it as unverified leads, run my filter chain, and tell me which survived, which fell out and on which filter, before verifying anything.

Apply to a program from my plan: find its real form, draft every answer from my profile and stories within the form's limits, lint it against my facts, fill it in my browser and verify every field — then finish the way my autonomy setting says.

Draft this week's investor emails: one per Tier 2 target, each with a hook from something verified on their own site, linted against my facts, saved as a note and as a Gmail draft. Do not send anything.
What's due? List follow-ups, program deadlines in the next two weeks and anything I need to re-verify — and draft the follow-ups that are due.

I heard back from an investor or a program. I'll paste the email or tell you what happened — log it against the right target, update the plan, and if it's a meeting, prep me from the target note and my stories.

settings.title: Fundraising Agent settings
settings.blurb: Materials the agent reads when it drafts applications and emails. They live in your brain, in the fundraising profile — nothing is uploaded anywhere.

files.label: Pitch deck
files.hint: PDF or PPTX. Onboarding reads it to fill your company facts; applications link or attach it.

files.label: Facts file / one-pager
files.hint: The source of truth for every claim — the agent will not state a number that is not in here or your profile.

files.label: Founder CV
files.hint: Used for the founder bio and for 'why you' answers.
